name: cfo-monthly-review
description: Close the month: collect statements, review against the budget, and write the summary.

month.help: Which month to close (YYYY-MM). Empty closes the previous full month.

metadata.when_not_to_use: not for tax filing — that is the quarterly-close runbook

config.prompt: Collect and normalise the statements for {{inputs.month}} (empty = the previous full month). Report the row count per source file and name anything you could not parse.
Using {{nodes.collect.output}}, review the month against the three-month median. State the unclassified share first, then the three largest deltas and what drove them.
